about_the_game:
Armada Pet Wars (APW) Demo is a 4X-lite asynchronous turn based space-themed strategy game... with pets.

APW is designed for up to 8 (human or AI) players to play multiplayer games over several weeks asynchronously, or Challenge the AI players directly for direct-ongoing play.

Demo Mechanics include :

  • A randomized Technology Tree that keeps each game fresh, requiring players to adjust and design strategies based on what technology they start with.

  • Starship design on numerous (29) ship hull types of various sizes and complexity, requiring players to design Starships with various components and weapon layouts. Starship designs will determine how they will interact in battle, allowing for large and tactical auto-battle outcomes.

  • Simplified, but strategic Grand Strategy, which includes a Galactic Resource Market, anonymous player communication, and diplomacy.

  • Single Player Skirmish Mode: Compete against 1-7 AI competitors on 6 various sized maps on easy, medium or hard modes of play.

  • Multiplayer Mode: Multiplayer games are from 2 to 8 players and can be setup in easy, medium and hard modes of play. AI players will attempt to destroy all human players, and human players can ally with each other against other human or AI players. Most demo maps currently setup for the demo allow for 2 players to win the game (except the 2 player map)

  • Currently the demo version does not let you start your own multiplayer server, you can use the default server that has been set up for demo use within the demo.

  • Join my discord to coordinate server games with others, as steam functionality for joining servers is not setup for this demo.

  • The Demo is only in English.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 x64
  • Processor: Intel or AMD Dual Core CPU
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce 9600 GT or AMD Radeon HD 2400
  • Storage: 400 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard Integrated Cards
  • VR Support: No VR Support

short_description: Armada Pet Wars is a 4X-lite asynchronous turn based space-themed strategy game... with pets. Design Starships, make or break alliances, setup your fleets for victory in this strategic, space-themed, auto-battler.
